## Actions

### artifacts.delete

`actions.artifacts.delete`

Deletes a specific artifact for a workflow run

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.actions.artifacts.delete({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', artifact_id: '9' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repository |
| `artifact_id` | `string \| number` | Yes | id of the artifact |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### artifacts.download

`actions.artifacts.download`

Downloads a specific artifact for a workflow run redirects to blob url (returned as a file)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.actions.artifacts.download({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', artifact_id: '9' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repository |
| `artifact_id` | `string \| number` | Yes | id of the artifact |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contentBase64` | `string` | No | The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set. |
| `text` | `string` | No | The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8. |
| `contentType` | `string` | Yes | Media type of the file, for example application/pdf. |
| `byteLength` | `number` | Yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `filename` | `string` | No | The file name, when known. |
| `contentOmitted` | `not_requested \| over_limit` | No | Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit. |
| `fileId` | `string` | No | Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text. |



---

### artifacts.get

`actions.artifacts.get`

Gets a specific artifact for a workflow run

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.actions.artifacts.get({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', artifact_id: '9' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repository |
| `artifact_id` | `string \| number` | Yes | id of the artifact |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `archive_download_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `expired` | `boolean \| null` | No | — |
| `expires_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `size_in_bytes` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `updated_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `workflow_run` | `object \| null` | No | ActionWorkflowRun represents a WorkflowRun |

---

### artifacts.list

`actions.artifacts.list`

Lists all artifacts for a repository

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.actions.artifacts.list({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repository |
| `name` | `string` | No | name of the artifact |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `artifacts` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `total_count` | `number \| null` | No | — |

### jobs.downloadLogs

`actions.jobs.downloadLogs`

Downloads the job logs for a workflow run (returned as a file)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.actions.jobs.downloadLogs({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', job_id: 41 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repository |
| `job_id` | `number` | Yes | id of the job |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contentBase64` | `string` | No | The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set. |
| `text` | `string` | No | The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8. |
| `contentType` | `string` | Yes | Media type of the file, for example application/pdf. |
| `byteLength` | `number` | Yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `filename` | `string` | No | The file name, when known. |
| `contentOmitted` | `not_requested \| over_limit` | No | Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit. |
| `fileId` | `string` | No | Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text. |

---

### runs.artifacts.list

`actions.runs.artifacts.list`

Lists all artifacts for a repository run

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.actions.runs.artifacts.list({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', run: 17 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repository |
| `run` | `number` | Yes | runid of the workflow run |
| `name` | `string` | No | name of the artifact |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `artifacts` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `total_count` | `number \| null` | No | — |

---

### runs.attempts.get

`actions.runs.attempts.get`

Gets a specific workflow run attempt

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.actions.runs.attempts.get({
	owner: 'ada',
	repo: 'website',
	run: 17,
	attempt: 1,
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repository |
| `run` | `number` | Yes | id of the run |
| `attempt` | `number` | Yes | logical attempt number of the run |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `actor` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |
| `artifacts_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `cancel_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `completed_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `conclusion` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `display_title` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `event` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `head_branch` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `head_repository` | `object \| null` | No | Repository represents a repository |
| `head_sha` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `html_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `jobs_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `logs_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `path` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `previous_attempt_url` | `string \| null` | No | PreviousAttemptURL is the API URL of the previous attempt of this run, e.g. ".../actions/runs/&#123;run_id&#125;/attempts/&#123;attempt-1&#125;". It is set only when the current attempt is &gt; 1 (i.e. a rerun). For the first attempt, or for legacy runs that pre-date ActionRunAttempt, it is null. |
| `pull_requests` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `repository` | `object \| null` | No | Repository represents a repository |
| `repository_id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `rerun_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `run_attempt` | `number \| null` | No | RunAttempt is 1-based for runs created after ActionRunAttempt was introduced. A value of 0 is a legacy-only sentinel for runs created before attempts existed and indicates no corresponding /attempts/&#123;n&#125; resource is available. |
| `run_number` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `started_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `trigger_actor` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |
| `updated_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | — |

### runs.attempts.jobs.list

`actions.runs.attempts.jobs.list`

Lists all jobs for a workflow run attempt

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.actions.runs.attempts.jobs.list({
	owner: 'ada',
	repo: 'website',
	run: 17,
	attempt: 1,
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repository |
| `run` | `number` | Yes | id of the workflow run |
| `attempt` | `number` | Yes | logical attempt number of the run |
| `status` | `string` | No | workflow status (requested, pending, queued, in_progress, failure, success, skipped) |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `jobs` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `total_count` | `number \| null` | No | — |

### runs.cancel

`actions.runs.cancel`

Cancel a workflow run and its jobs

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.actions.runs.cancel({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', run: 17 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repository |
| `run` | `number` | Yes | run ID |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `actor` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |
| `artifacts_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `cancel_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `completed_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `conclusion` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `display_title` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `event` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `head_branch` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `head_repository` | `object \| null` | No | Repository represents a repository |
| `head_sha` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `html_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `jobs_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `logs_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `path` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `previous_attempt_url` | `string \| null` | No | PreviousAttemptURL is the API URL of the previous attempt of this run, e.g. ".../actions/runs/&#123;run_id&#125;/attempts/&#123;attempt-1&#125;". It is set only when the current attempt is &gt; 1 (i.e. a rerun). For the first attempt, or for legacy runs that pre-date ActionRunAttempt, it is null. |
| `pull_requests` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `repository` | `object \| null` | No | Repository represents a repository |
| `repository_id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `rerun_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `run_attempt` | `number \| null` | No | RunAttempt is 1-based for runs created after ActionRunAttempt was introduced. A value of 0 is a legacy-only sentinel for runs created before attempts existed and indicates no corresponding /attempts/&#123;n&#125; resource is available. |
| `run_number` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `started_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `trigger_actor` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |
| `updated_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | — |

---

### runs.delete

`actions.runs.delete`

Delete a workflow run

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.actions.runs.delete({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', run: 17 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repository |
| `run` | `number` | Yes | runid of the workflow run |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### runs.downloadLogs

`actions.runs.downloadLogs`

Download workflow run logs as archive (returned as a file)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.actions.runs.downloadLogs({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', run: 17 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repository |
| `run` | `number` | Yes | run ID |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contentBase64` | `string` | No | The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set. |
| `text` | `string` | No | The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8. |
| `contentType` | `string` | Yes | Media type of the file, for example application/pdf. |
| `byteLength` | `number` | Yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `filename` | `string` | No | The file name, when known. |
| `contentOmitted` | `not_requested \| over_limit` | No | Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit. |
| `fileId` | `string` | No | Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text. |

### runs.forceCancel

`actions.runs.forceCancel`

Force-cancel a workflow run

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.actions.runs.forceCancel({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', run: 17 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repository |
| `run` | `number` | Yes | run ID |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `actor` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |
| `artifacts_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `cancel_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `completed_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `conclusion` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `display_title` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `event` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `head_branch` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `head_repository` | `object \| null` | No | Repository represents a repository |
| `head_sha` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `html_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `jobs_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `logs_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `path` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `previous_attempt_url` | `string \| null` | No | PreviousAttemptURL is the API URL of the previous attempt of this run, e.g. ".../actions/runs/&#123;run_id&#125;/attempts/&#123;attempt-1&#125;". It is set only when the current attempt is &gt; 1 (i.e. a rerun). For the first attempt, or for legacy runs that pre-date ActionRunAttempt, it is null. |
| `pull_requests` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `repository` | `object \| null` | No | Repository represents a repository |
| `repository_id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `rerun_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `run_attempt` | `number \| null` | No | RunAttempt is 1-based for runs created after ActionRunAttempt was introduced. A value of 0 is a legacy-only sentinel for runs created before attempts existed and indicates no corresponding /attempts/&#123;n&#125; resource is available. |
| `run_number` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `started_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `trigger_actor` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |
| `updated_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | — |

---

### runs.get

`actions.runs.get`

Gets a specific workflow run

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.actions.runs.get({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', run: 17 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repository |
| `run` | `number` | Yes | id of the run |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `actor` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |
| `artifacts_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `cancel_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `completed_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `conclusion` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `display_title` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `event` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `head_branch` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `head_repository` | `object \| null` | No | Repository represents a repository |
| `head_sha` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `html_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `jobs_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `logs_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `path` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `previous_attempt_url` | `string \| null` | No | PreviousAttemptURL is the API URL of the previous attempt of this run, e.g. ".../actions/runs/&#123;run_id&#125;/attempts/&#123;attempt-1&#125;". It is set only when the current attempt is &gt; 1 (i.e. a rerun). For the first attempt, or for legacy runs that pre-date ActionRunAttempt, it is null. |
| `pull_requests` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `repository` | `object \| null` | No | Repository represents a repository |
| `repository_id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `rerun_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `run_attempt` | `number \| null` | No | RunAttempt is 1-based for runs created after ActionRunAttempt was introduced. A value of 0 is a legacy-only sentinel for runs created before attempts existed and indicates no corresponding /attempts/&#123;n&#125; resource is available. |
| `run_number` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `started_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `trigger_actor` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |
| `updated_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | — |

### runs.jobs.list

`actions.runs.jobs.list`

Lists all jobs for a workflow run

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.actions.runs.jobs.list({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', run: 17 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repository |
| `run` | `number` | Yes | runid of the workflow run |
| `status` | `string` | No | workflow status (requested, pending, queued, in_progress, failure, success, skipped) |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |
| `sort` | `string` | No | sort jobs by attribute. Supported values are "id". Default is "id" |
| `order` | `string` | No | sort order, either "asc" (ascending) or "desc" (descending). Default is "asc" |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `jobs` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `total_count` | `number \| null` | No | — |

### runs.jobs.rerun

`actions.runs.jobs.rerun`

Reruns a specific workflow job in a run

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.actions.runs.jobs.rerun({
	owner: 'ada',
	repo: 'website',
	run: 17,
	job_id: 41,
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repository |
| `run` | `number` | Yes | id of the run |
| `job_id` | `number` | Yes | id of the job |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `completed_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |

| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `head_branch` | `string \| null` | No | — |

---

### runs.list

`actions.runs.list`

Lists all runs for a repository run

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.actions.runs.list({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repository |
| `event` | `string` | No | workflow event name |
| `branch` | `string` | No | workflow branch |
| `status` | `string` | No | workflow status (requested, pending, queued, in_progress, failure, success, skipped) |
| `actor` | `string` | No | triggered by user |
| `head_sha` | `string` | No | triggering sha of the workflow run |
| `exclude_pull_requests` | `boolean` | No | if true, the `pull_requests` field on each returned run is emptied |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `total_count` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `workflow_runs` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

---

### runs.rerun

`actions.runs.rerun`

Reruns an entire workflow run

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.actions.runs.rerun({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', run: 17 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repository |
| `run` | `number` | Yes | id of the run |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `actor` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |
| `artifacts_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `cancel_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `completed_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `conclusion` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `display_title` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `event` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `head_branch` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `head_repository` | `object \| null` | No | Repository represents a repository |
| `head_sha` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `html_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `jobs_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `logs_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `path` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `previous_attempt_url` | `string \| null` | No | PreviousAttemptURL is the API URL of the previous attempt of this run, e.g. ".../actions/runs/&#123;run_id&#125;/attempts/&#123;attempt-1&#125;". It is set only when the current attempt is &gt; 1 (i.e. a rerun). For the first attempt, or for legacy runs that pre-date ActionRunAttempt, it is null. |
| `pull_requests` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `repository` | `object \| null` | No | Repository represents a repository |
| `repository_id` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `rerun_url` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `run_attempt` | `number \| null` | No | RunAttempt is 1-based for runs created after ActionRunAttempt was introduced. A value of 0 is a legacy-only sentinel for runs created before attempts existed and indicates no corresponding /attempts/&#123;n&#125; resource is available. |
| `run_number` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `started_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `trigger_actor` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |
| `updated_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | — |

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.admin.actions.jobs.list({});
```

|------|------|----------|-------------|

| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |
| `sort` | `string` | No | sort jobs by attribute. Supported values are "id". Default is "id" |
| `order` | `string` | No | sort order, either "asc" (ascending) or "desc" (descending). Default is "asc" |

### cron.list

`admin.cron.list`

List cron tasks, one page at a time (site admins only)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.admin.cron.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="items full type">

```ts
{
  exec_times?: number | null,
  name?: string | null,
  next?: string | null,
  prev?: string | null,
  schedule?: string | null
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### cron.run

`admin.cron.run`

| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### hooks.create

`admin.hooks.create`

Create a hook (site admins only)

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.admin.hooks.create({
	type: 'dingtalk',
	config: {},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `active` | `boolean` | No | Whether the webhook should be active upon creation |
| `authorization_header` | `string` | No | Authorization header to include in webhook requests |
| `branch_filter` | `string` | No | Branch filter pattern to determine which branches trigger the webhook |
| `config` | `Record<string, string>` | Yes | CreateHookOptionConfig has all config options in it required are "content_type" and "url" Required |
| `events` | `string[]` | No | List of events that will trigger this webhook |
| `name` | `string` | No | Optional human-readable name for the webhook |
| `type` | `dingtalk \| discord \| gitea \| gogs \| msteams \| slack \| telegram \| feishu \| wechatwork \| packagist` | Yes | The type of the webhook to create |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `active` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the webhook is active and will be triggered |
| `authorization_header` | `string \| null` | No | Authorization header to include in webhook requests |
| `branch_filter` | `string \| null` | No | Branch filter pattern to determine which branches trigger the webhook |
| `config` | `Record<string, string> \| null` | No | Configuration settings for the webhook |
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | The date and time when the webhook was created |
| `events` | `string[] \| null` | No | List of events that trigger this webhook |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | The unique identifier of the webhook |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Optional human-readable name for the webhook |
| `type` | `string \| null` | No | The type of the webhook (e.g., gitea, slack, discord) |
| `updated_at` | `string \| null` | No | The date and time when the webhook was last updated |

### unadopted.adopt

`admin.unadopted.adopt`

Adopt unadopted files as a repository (site admins only)

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.admin.unadopted.adopt({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### unadopted.list

`admin.unadopted.list`

List unadopted repositories, one page at a time (site admins only)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.admin.unadopted.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |
| `query` | `string` | No | glob pattern of repositories to search for, in the form owner or owner/repo |



**Output**

|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `string[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

### users.create

`admin.users.create`

Create a user (site admins only)

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.admin.users.create({
	username: 'grace',
	email: 'grace@example.com',
	password: 'correct-horse-battery-staple',
	must_change_password: true,
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `created_at` | `string` | No | For explicitly setting the user creation timestamp. Useful when users are migrated from other systems. When omitted, the user's creation timestamp will be set to "now". |
| `email` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `full_name` | `string` | No | The full display name of the user |
| `login_name` | `string` | No | identifier of the user, provided by the external authenticator (if configured) |
| `must_change_password` | `boolean` | No | Whether the user must change password on first login |
| `password` | `string` | No | The plain text password for the user |
| `restricted` | `boolean` | No | Whether the user has restricted access privileges |
| `send_notify` | `boolean` | No | Whether to send welcome notification email to the user |
| `source_id` | `number` | No | The authentication source ID to associate with the user |
| `username` | `string` | Yes | username of the user |
| `visibility` | `public \| limited \| private` | No | User visibility level: public, limited, or private |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `active` | `boolean \| null` | No | Is user active |
| `avatar_url` | `string \| null` | No | URL to the user's avatar |
| `created` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `description` | `string \| null` | No | the user's description |
| `email` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `followers_count` | `number \| null` | No | user counts |
| `following_count` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `full_name` | `string \| null` | No | the user's full name |
| `html_url` | `string \| null` | No | URL to the user's gitea page |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | the user's id |
| `is_admin` | `boolean \| null` | No | Is the user an administrator |
| `language` | `string \| null` | No | User locale |
| `last_login` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `location` | `string \| null` | No | the user's location |
| `login` | `string \| null` | No | login of the user, same as `username` |
| `login_name` | `string \| null` | No | identifier of the user, provided by the external authenticator (if configured) |
| `prohibit_login` | `boolean \| null` | No | Is user login prohibited |
| `restricted` | `boolean \| null` | No | Is user restricted |
| `source_id` | `number \| null` | No | The ID of the user's Authentication Source |
| `starred_repos_count` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `type` | `string \| null` | No | the user type |
| `visibility` | `string \| null` | No | User visibility level option: public, limited, private |
| `website` | `string \| null` | No | the user's website |

### users.keys.create

`admin.users.keys.create`

Add a public key on behalf of a user (site admins only)

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.admin.users.keys.create({ username: 'ada', title: 'Login fails on Safari', key: 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIGitea0example0key0value0for0docs ada@example.com' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `username` | `string` | Yes | username of the user who is to receive a public key |
| `key` | `string` | Yes | An armored SSH key to add |
| `read_only` | `boolean` | No | Describe if the key has only read access or read/write |
| `title` | `string` | Yes | Title of the key to add |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | Created is the time when the key was added |
| `fingerprint` | `string \| null` | No | Fingerprint is the key's fingerprint |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | ID is the unique identifier for the public key |
| `key` | `string \| null` | No | Key contains the actual SSH public key content |
| `key_type` | `string \| null` | No | KeyType indicates the type of the SSH key |
| `last_used_at` | `string \| null` | No | Updated is the time when the key was last used |
| `read_only` | `boolean \| null` | No | ReadOnly indicates if the key has read-only access |
| `title` | `string \| null` | No | Title is the human-readable name for the key |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | URL is the API URL for this key |
| `user` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |

### users.list

`admin.users.list`

Search users according filter conditions, one page at a time (site admins only)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.admin.users.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `source_id` | `number` | No | ID of the user's login source to search for |
| `login_name` | `string` | No | identifier of the user, provided by the external authenticator |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |
| `sort` | `string` | No | sort users by attribute. Supported values are "name", "created", "updated" and "id". Default is "name" |
| `order` | `string` | No | sort order, either "asc" (ascending) or "desc" (descending). Default is "asc", ignored if "sort" is not specified. |
| `q` | `string` | No | search term (username, full name, email) |
| `visibility` | `string` | No | visibility filter. Supported values are "public", "limited" and "private". |
| `is_active` | `boolean` | No | filter active users |
| `is_admin` | `boolean` | No | filter admin users |
| `is_restricted` | `boolean` | No | filter restricted users |
| `is_2fa_enabled` | `boolean` | No | filter 2FA enabled users |
| `is_prohibit_login` | `boolean` | No | filter login prohibited users |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

### users.update

`admin.users.update`

Edit an existing user (site admins only)

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.admin.users.update({ username: 'ada', source_id: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `username` | `string` | Yes | username of the user whose data is to be edited |
| `active` | `boolean` | No | Whether the user account is active |
| `admin` | `boolean` | No | Whether the user has administrator privileges |
| `allow_create_organization` | `boolean` | No | Whether the user can create organizations |
| `allow_git_hook` | `boolean` | No | Whether the user can use Git hooks |
| `allow_import_local` | `boolean` | No | Whether the user can import local repositories |
| `description` | `string` | No | The user's personal description or bio |
| `email` | `string` | No | The email address of the user |
| `full_name` | `string` | No | The full display name of the user |
| `location` | `string` | No | The user's location or address |
| `login_name` | `string` | No | identifier of the user, provided by the external authenticator (if configured) |
| `max_repo_creation` | `number` | No | Maximum number of repositories the user can create |
| `must_change_password` | `boolean` | No | Whether the user must change password on next login |
| `password` | `string` | No | The plain text password for the user |
| `prohibit_login` | `boolean` | No | Whether the user is prohibited from logging in |
| `restricted` | `boolean` | No | Whether the user has restricted access privileges |
| `source_id` | `number` | Yes | The authentication source ID to associate with the user |
| `type` | `User \| Organization \| Bot` | No | The user type |
| `visibility` | `public \| limited \| private` | No | User visibility level: public, limited, or private |
| `website` | `string` | No | The user's personal website URL |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `active` | `boolean \| null` | No | Is user active |
| `avatar_url` | `string \| null` | No | URL to the user's avatar |
| `created` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `description` | `string \| null` | No | the user's description |
| `email` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `followers_count` | `number \| null` | No | user counts |
| `following_count` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `full_name` | `string \| null` | No | the user's full name |
| `html_url` | `string \| null` | No | URL to the user's gitea page |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | the user's id |
| `is_admin` | `boolean \| null` | No | Is the user an administrator |
| `language` | `string \| null` | No | User locale |
| `last_login` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `location` | `string \| null` | No | the user's location |
| `login` | `string \| null` | No | login of the user, same as `username` |

| `source_id` | `number \| null` | No | The ID of the user's Authentication Source |
| `starred_repos_count` | `number \| null` | No | — |
| `type` | `string \| null` | No | the user type |
| `visibility` | `string \| null` | No | User visibility level option: public, limited, private |

## Branches

### create

`branches.create`

Create a branch

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.branches.create({
	owner: 'ada',
	repo: 'website',
	new_branch_name: 'feature/login',
	old_ref_name: 'main',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `new_branch_name` | `string` | Yes | Name of the branch to create |
| `old_branch_name` | `string` | No | Name of the old branch to create from |
| `old_ref_name` | `string` | No | Name of the old branch/tag/commit to create from |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `commit` | `object \| null` | No | PayloadCommit represents a commit |
| `effective_branch_protection_name` | `string \| null` | No | EffectiveBranchProtectionName is the name of the effective branch protection rule |
| `enable_status_check` | `boolean \| null` | No | EnableStatusCheck indicates if status checks are enabled |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Name is the branch name |
| `protected` | `boolean \| null` | No | Protected indicates if the branch is protected |
| `required_approvals` | `number \| null` | No | RequiredApprovals is the number of required approvals for pull requests |
| `status_check_contexts` | `string[] \| null` | No | StatusCheckContexts contains the list of required status check contexts |
| `user_can_merge` | `boolean \| null` | No | UserCanMerge indicates if the current user can merge to this branch |
| `user_can_push` | `boolean \| null` | No | UserCanPush indicates if the current user can push to this branch |

### delete

`branches.delete`

Delete a specific branch from a repository

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.branches.delete({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', branch: 'main' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `branch` | `string` | Yes | branch to delete |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

**Risk:** `read`

```ts

```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `branch` | `string` | Yes | branch to get |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `commit` | `object \| null` | No | PayloadCommit represents a commit |

| `protected` | `boolean \| null` | No | Protected indicates if the branch is protected |
| `required_approvals` | `number \| null` | No | RequiredApprovals is the number of required approvals for pull requests |
| `status_check_contexts` | `string[] \| null` | No | StatusCheckContexts contains the list of required status check contexts |
| `user_can_merge` | `boolean \| null` | No | UserCanMerge indicates if the current user can merge to this branch |
| `user_can_push` | `boolean \| null` | No | UserCanPush indicates if the current user can push to this branch |

### setCommit

`branches.setCommit`

Point a branch at another commit; when the new commit is not a descendant this rewrites the branch's history like a force-push

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.branches.setCommit({
	owner: 'ada',
	repo: 'website',
	branch: 'main',
	new_commit_id: '6e4269bf64d3ce786c4ca996916a43555eeddba4',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `branch` | `string` | Yes | name of the branch |
| `force` | `boolean` | No | Force update even if the change is not a fast-forward |
| `new_commit_id` | `string` | Yes | New commit SHA (or any ref) the branch should point to |
| `old_commit_id` | `string` | No | Expected old commit SHA of the branch; if provided it must match the current tip |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### compare

**Risk:** `read`

| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `basehead` | `string` | Yes | compare two refs as `base...head` (or `base..head`); refs may be branches, tags, full or short SHAs (including branch names that contain slashes), optionally with a `^` or `~N` revision suffix. |
| `output` | `diff \| patch` | No | return the raw comparison as `diff` or `patch` instead of JSON |
| `verification` | `boolean` | No | include verification for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true') |

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.commits.downloadDiff({
	owner: 'ada',
	repo: 'website',
	sha: '6e4269bf64d3ce786c4ca996916a43555eeddba4',
	diffType: 'diff',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `sha` | `string` | Yes | SHA of the commit to get |
| `diffType` | `diff \| patch` | Yes | whether the output is diff or patch |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `text` | `string` | Yes | The body Gitea answered with (text, HTML or a diff). |

### get

`commits.get`

Get a single commit from a repository, it has a GitHub-compatible alias "/repos/&#123;owner&#125;/&#123;repo&#125;/commits/&#123;ref&#125;"

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.commits.get({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', sha: '6e4269bf64d3ce786c4ca996916a43555eeddba4' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `sha` | `string` | Yes | a git ref or commit sha |
| `stat` | `boolean` | No | include diff stats for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true') |
| `verification` | `boolean` | No | include verification for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true') |
| `files` | `boolean` | No | include a list of affected files for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true') |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `author` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |
| `commit` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `committer` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |
| `created` | `string \| null` | No | Created is the time when the commit was created |
| `files` | `object[] \| null` | No | Files contains information about files affected by the commit |
| `html_url` | `string \| null` | No | HTMLURL is the web URL for viewing the commit |
| `parents` | `object[] \| null` | No | Parents contains the parent commit information |
| `sha` | `string \| null` | No | SHA is the commit SHA hash |
| `stats` | `object \| null` | No | CommitStats is statistics for a RepoCommit |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | URL is the API URL for the commit |

### list

`commits.list`

List a repository's commits, newest first, optionally from a ref, path or time window, one page at a time; a repository with no commits answers 409

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.commits.list({
	owner: 'gitea',
	repo: 'tea',
	sha: 'main',
	limit: 10,
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `sha` | `string` | No | SHA or branch to start listing commits from (usually 'master') |
| `path` | `string` | No | filepath of a file/dir |
| `since` | `string` | No | Only commits after this date will be returned (ISO 8601 format) |
| `until` | `string` | No | Only commits before this date will be returned (ISO 8601 format) |
| `stat` | `boolean` | No | include diff stats for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true') |
| `verification` | `boolean` | No | include verification for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true') |
| `files` | `boolean` | No | include a list of affected files for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true') |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results (ignored if used with 'path') |
| `not` | `string` | No | commits that match the given specifier will not be listed. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

---

### statuses.combined

`commits.statuses.combined`

Get a commit's combined status, by branch/tag/commit reference

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.commits.statuses.combined({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', ref: 'main' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `ref` | `string` | Yes | name of branch/tag/commit |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `commit_url` | `string \| null` | No | CommitURL is the API URL for the commit |
| `repository` | `object \| null` | No | Repository represents a repository |
| `sha` | `string \| null` | No | SHA is the commit SHA this status applies to |
| `state` | `string \| null` | No | State is the overall combined status state |
| `statuses` | `object[] \| null` | No | Statuses contains all individual commit statuses |
| `total_count` | `number \| null` | No | TotalCount is the total number of statuses |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | URL is the API URL for this combined status |

### statuses.create

`commits.statuses.create`

Create a commit status

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.commits.statuses.create({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', sha: '6e4269bf64d3ce786c4ca996916a43555eeddba4' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `sha` | `string` | Yes | sha of the commit |
| `context` | `string` | No | Context is the unique context identifier for the status |
| `description` | `string` | No | Description provides a brief description of the status |
| `state` | `pending \| success \| error \| failure \| warning \| skipped` | No | State represents the status state to set (pending, success, error, failure) |
| `target_url` | `string` | No | TargetURL is the URL to link to for more details |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `context` | `string \| null` | No | Context is the unique context identifier for the status |
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `creator` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |
| `description` | `string \| null` | No | Description provides a brief description of the status |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | ID is the unique identifier for the commit status |
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | State represents the status state (pending, success, error, failure) |
| `target_url` | `string \| null` | No | TargetURL is the URL to link to for more details |
| `updated_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | URL is the API URL for this status |

## Contents

### applyPatch

`contents.applyPatch`

Apply a unified diff to the repository as a new commit on a branch

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.contents.applyPatch({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', content: 'Looks good to me.' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `author` | `object` | No | Identity for a person's identity like an author or committer |
| `branch` | `string` | No | branch (optional) is the base branch for the changes. If not supplied, the default branch is used |
| `committer` | `object` | No | Identity for a person's identity like an author or committer |
| `content` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `dates` | `object` | No | CommitDateOptions store dates for GIT_AUTHOR_DATE and GIT_COMMITTER_DATE |
| `force_push` | `boolean` | No | force_push (optional) will do a force-push if the new branch already exists |
| `message` | `string` | No | message (optional) is the commit message of the changes. If not supplied, a default message will be used |
| `new_branch` | `string` | No | new_branch (optional) will make a new branch from base branch for the changes. If not supplied, the changes will be committed to the base branch |
| `signoff` | `boolean` | No | Add a Signed-off-by trailer by the committer at the end of the commit log message. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="author full type">

```ts
{
  email?: string,
  name?: string
}
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="committer full type">

```ts
{
  email?: string,
  name?: string
}
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="dates full type">

```ts
{
  author?: string,
  committer?: string
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `commit` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `content` | `object \| null` | No | ContentsResponse contains information about a repo's entry's (dir, file, symlink, submodule) metadata and content |
| `verification` | `object \| null` | No | PayloadCommitVerification represents the GPG verification of a commit |

### create

`contents.create`

Create a file in a repository

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.contents.create({
	owner: 'ada',
	repo: 'website',
	filepath: 'docs/notes.md',
	content: 'SGVsbG8gZnJvbSBDb3JzYWly',
	message: 'Add notes',
	branch: 'main',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `filepath` | `string` | Yes | path of the file to create |
| `author` | `object` | No | Identity for a person's identity like an author or committer |
| `branch` | `string` | No | branch (optional) is the base branch for the changes. If not supplied, the default branch is used |
| `committer` | `object` | No | Identity for a person's identity like an author or committer |
| `content` | `string` | Yes | content must be base64 encoded |
| `dates` | `object` | No | CommitDateOptions store dates for GIT_AUTHOR_DATE and GIT_COMMITTER_DATE |
| `force_push` | `boolean` | No | force_push (optional) will do a force-push if the new branch already exists |

### get

`contents.get`

Gets the metadata and contents (if a file) of an entry in a repository, or a list of entries if a dir

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.contents.get({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', filepath: 'docs/README.md' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `filepath` | `string` | Yes | path of the dir, file, symlink or submodule in the repo |
| `ref` | `string` | No | The name of the commit/branch/tag. Default to the repository’s default branch. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `_links` | `object \| null` | No | FileLinksResponse contains the links for a repo's file |
| `content` | `string \| null` | No | `content` is populated when `type` is `file`, otherwise null |
| `download_url` | `string \| null` | No | DownloadURL is the direct download URL for this file |
| `encoding` | `string \| null` | No | `encoding` is populated when `type` is `file`, otherwise null |
| `git_url` | `string \| null` | No | GitURL is the Git API URL for this blob or tree |
| `html_url` | `string \| null` | No | HTMLURL is the web URL for this file or directory |
| `last_author_date` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `last_commit_message` | `string \| null` | No | LastCommitMessage is the message of the last commit that affected this file |
| `last_commit_sha` | `string \| null` | No | LastCommitSHA is the SHA of the last commit that affected this file |
| `last_committer_date` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `lfs_oid` | `string \| null` | No | LfsOid is the Git LFS object ID if this file is stored in LFS |
| `lfs_size` | `number \| null` | No | LfsSize is the file size if this file is stored in LFS |
| `mode` | `string \| null` | No | `mode` is the Git file mode as an octal string, e.g. `100644` (regular), `100755` (executable), `120000` (symlink), `160000` (submodule) |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Name is the file or directory name |
| `path` | `string \| null` | No | Path is the full path to the file or directory |
| `sha` | `string \| null` | No | SHA is the Git blob or tree SHA |
| `size` | `number \| null` | No | Size is the file size in bytes |
| `submodule_git_url` | `string \| null` | No | `submodule_git_url` is populated when `type` is `submodule`, otherwise null |
| `target` | `string \| null` | No | `target` is populated when `type` is `symlink`, otherwise null |
| `type` | `string \| null` | No | `type` will be `file`, `dir`, `symlink`, or `submodule` |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | URL is the API URL for this file or directory |

### media

`contents.media`

Get a file or it's LFS object from a repository (returned as a file)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.contents.media({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', filepath: 'docs/README.md' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `filepath` | `string` | Yes | path of the file to get, it should be "&#123;ref&#125;/&#123;filepath&#125;". If there is no ref could be inferred, it will be treated as the default branch |
| `ref` | `string` | No | The name of the commit/branch/tag. Default to the repository’s default branch |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contentBase64` | `string` | No | The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set. |
| `text` | `string` | No | The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8. |
| `contentType` | `string` | Yes | Media type of the file, for example application/pdf. |
| `byteLength` | `number` | Yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `filename` | `string` | No | The file name, when known. |
| `contentOmitted` | `not_requested \| over_limit` | No | Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit. |
| `fileId` | `string` | No | Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text. |

### attachments.create

`issues.attachments.create`

Create an issue attachment

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.issues.attachments.create({
	owner: 'ada',
	repo: 'website',
	index: 4,
	attachment: { base64: 'iVBORw0KGgo=', filename: 'screenshot.png', contentType: 'image/png' },
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `index` | `number` | Yes | index of the issue |
| `name` | `string` | No | name of the attachment |
| `attachment` | `string \| object \| custom` | Yes | attachment to upload |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="attachment full type">

```ts
string | {
  url: string,
  filename?: string,
  contentType?: string
} | {
  base64: string,
  filename?: string,
  contentType?: string
} | custom
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `browser_download_url` | `string \| null` | No | DownloadURL is the URL to download the attachment |
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | Created is the time when the attachment was uploaded |
| `download_count` | `number \| null` | No | DownloadCount is the number of times the attachment has been downloaded |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | ID is the unique identifier for the attachment |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Name is the filename of the attachment |
| `size` | `number \| null` | No | Size is the file size in bytes |
| `uuid` | `string \| null` | No | UUID is the unique identifier for the attachment file |

### delete

| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `index` | `number` | Yes | index of issue to delete |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### list

`issues.list`

List a repository's issues and pull requests, filterable by state, labels, milestone, assignee and time window, one page at a time; pass type 'issues' to leave pull requests out

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.issues.list({
	owner: 'gitea',
	repo: 'tea',
	state: 'open',
	type: 'issues',
	limit: 20,
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `state` | `closed \| open \| all` | No | whether issue is open or closed |
| `labels` | `string` | No | comma separated list of label names. Fetch only issues that have any of this label names. Non existent labels are discarded. |
| `q` | `string` | No | search string |
| `type` | `issues \| pulls` | No | filter by type (issues / pulls) if set |
| `milestones` | `string` | No | comma separated list of milestone names or ids. It uses names and fall back to ids. Fetch only issues that have any of this milestones. Non existent milestones are discarded |
| `since` | `string` | No | Only show items updated after the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format |
| `before` | `string` | No | Only show items updated before the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format |
| `created_by` | `string` | No | Only show items which were created by the given user |
| `assigned_by` | `string` | No | Only show items for which the given user is assigned |
| `mentioned_by` | `string` | No | Only show items in which the given user was mentioned |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

### search

`issues.search`

Search for issues across the repositories that the user has access to, one page at a time

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.issues.search({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `state` | `open \| closed \| all` | No | State of the issue |
| `labels` | `string` | No | Comma-separated list of label names. Fetch only issues that have any of these labels. Non existent labels are discarded. |
| `milestones` | `string` | No | Comma-separated list of milestone names. Fetch only issues that have any of these milestones. Non existent milestones are discarded. |
| `q` | `string` | No | Search string |
| `type` | `issues \| pulls` | No | Filter by issue type |
| `since` | `string` | No | Only show issues updated after the given time (RFC 3339 format) |
| `before` | `string` | No | Only show issues updated before the given time (RFC 3339 format) |
| `assigned` | `boolean` | No | Filter issues or pulls assigned to the authenticated user |
| `created` | `boolean` | No | Filter issues or pulls created by the authenticated user |
| `mentioned` | `boolean` | No | Filter issues or pulls mentioning the authenticated user |
| `review_requested` | `boolean` | No | Filter pull requests where the authenticated user's review was requested |
| `reviewed` | `boolean` | No | Filter pull requests reviewed by the authenticated user |
| `owner` | `string` | No | Filter by repository owner |
| `created_by` | `string` | No | Only show items which were created by the given user |
| `team` | `string` | No | Filter by team (requires organization owner parameter) |
| `page` | `number` | No | Page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | Number of items per page |

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

### setDeadline

`issues.setDeadline`

Set an issue deadline. If set to null, the deadline is deleted. If using deadline only the date will be taken into account, and time of day ignored

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.issues.setDeadline({
	owner: 'ada',
	repo: 'website',
	index: 4,
	due_date: '2026-04-09',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `index` | `number` | Yes | index of the issue to create or update a deadline on |
| `due_date` | `string` | Yes | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `due_date` | `string \| null` | No | — |

### stopwatch.delete

`issues.stopwatch.delete`

Delete an issue's existing stopwatch

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.issues.stopwatch.delete({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', index: 4 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `index` | `number` | Yes | index of the issue to stop the stopwatch on |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### subscriptions.check

`issues.subscriptions.check`

Check if user is subscribed to an issue

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.issues.subscriptions.check({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', index: 4 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `index` | `number` | Yes | index of the issue |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | The timestamp when the watch status was created |
| `ignored` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether notifications for the repository are ignored |
| `reason` | `any \| null` | No | The reason for the current watch status |
| `repository_url` | `string \| null` | No | The URL of the repository being watched |
| `subscribed` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the repository is being watched for notifications |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | The URL for managing the watch status |

### subscriptions.list

`issues.subscriptions.list`

### timeline

`issues.timeline`

List all comments and events on an issue, one page at a time

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.issues.timeline({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', index: 4 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `index` | `number` | Yes | index of the issue |
| `since` | `string` | No | if provided, only comments updated since the specified time are returned. |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |
| `before` | `string` | No | if provided, only comments updated before the provided time are returned. |

| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

### times.add

`issues.times.add`

Add tracked time to a issue

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.issues.times.add({
	owner: 'ada',
	repo: 'website',
	index: 4,
	time: 3600,
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `index` | `number` | Yes | index of the issue |
| `created` | `string` | No | — |
| `time` | `number` | Yes | time in seconds |
| `user_name` | `string` | No | username of the user who spent the time working on the issue (optional) |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `created` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | ID is the unique identifier for the tracked time entry |
| `issue` | `object \| null` | No | Issue represents an issue in a repository |
| `issue_id` | `number \| null` | No | deprecated (only for backwards compatibility) |
| `time` | `number \| null` | No | Time in seconds |
| `user_id` | `number \| null` | No | deprecated (only for backwards compatibility) |
| `user_name` | `string \| null` | No | username of the user |

### times.delete

`issues.times.delete`

Delete specific tracked time

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.issues.times.delete({
	owner: 'ada',
	repo: 'website',
	index: 4,
	id: 12,
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `index` | `number` | Yes | index of the issue |
| `id` | `number` | Yes | id of time to delete |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### times.list

`issues.times.list`

List an issue's tracked times, one page at a time

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.issues.times.list({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', index: 4 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `index` | `number` | Yes | index of the issue |
| `user` | `string` | No | optional filter by user (available for issue managers) |
| `since` | `string` | No | Only show times updated after the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format |
| `before` | `string` | No | Only show times updated before the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

### list

`notifications.list`

List users's notification threads, one page at a time

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.notifications.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `all` | `boolean` | No | If true, show notifications marked as read. Default value is false |
| `status-types` | `string[]` | No | Show notifications with the provided status types. Options are: unread, read and/or pinned. Defaults to unread & pinned. |
| `subject-type` | `(issue \| pull \| commit \| repository)[]` | No | filter notifications by subject type |
| `since` | `string` | No | Only show notifications updated after the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format |
| `before` | `string` | No | Only show notifications updated before the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

| `subject-type` | `(issue \| pull \| commit \| repository)[]` | No | filter notifications by subject type |
| `since` | `string` | No | Only show notifications updated after the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format |
| `before` | `string` | No | Only show notifications updated before the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

### markRead

`notifications.markRead`

Mark notification threads as read, pinned or unread

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.notifications.markRead({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `last_read_at` | `string` | No | Describes the last point that notifications were checked. Anything updated since this time will not be updated. |
| `all` | `string` | No | If true, mark all notifications on this repo. Default value is false |
| `status-types` | `string[]` | No | Mark notifications with the provided status types. Options are: unread, read and/or pinned. Defaults to unread. |
| `to-status` | `string` | No | Status to mark notifications as, Defaults to read. |



**Output:** `object[] \| object`

### markReadForRepo

`notifications.markReadForRepo`

Mark notification threads as read, pinned or unread on a specific repo

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.notifications.markReadForRepo({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `all` | `string` | No | If true, mark all notifications on this repo. Default value is false |
| `status-types` | `string[]` | No | Mark notifications with the provided status types. Options are: unread, read and/or pinned. Defaults to unread. |
| `to-status` | `string` | No | Status to mark notifications as. Defaults to read. |

### threads.get

`notifications.threads.get`

Get notification thread by ID

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.notifications.threads.get({ id: '12' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string \| number` | Yes | id of notification thread |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | ID is the unique identifier for the notification thread |
| `pinned` | `boolean \| null` | No | Pinned indicates if the notification is pinned |
| `repository` | `object \| null` | No | Repository represents a repository |
| `subject` | `object \| null` | No | NotificationSubject contains the notification subject (Issue/Pull/Commit) |
| `unread` | `boolean \| null` | No | Unread indicates if the notification has been read |
| `updated_at` | `string \| null` | No | UpdatedAt is the time when the notification was last updated |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | URL is the API URL for this notification thread |

## Orgs

### actions.jobs.list

`orgs.actions.jobs.list`

Get org-level workflow jobs

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.orgs.actions.jobs.list({ org: 'acme' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `org` | `string` | Yes | name of the organization |
| `status` | `string` | No | workflow status (requested, pending, queued, in_progress, failure, success, skipped) |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `jobs` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `total_count` | `number \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="jobs full type">

```ts
{
  completed_at?: string | null,
  conclusion?: string | null,
  created_at?: string | null,
  head_branch?: string | null,
  head_sha?: string | null,
  html_url?: string | null,
  id?: number | null,
  labels?: string[] | null,
  name?: string | null,
  run_attempt?: number | null,
  run_id?: number | null,

  }[] | null,
  url?: string | null
}[] | null
```


| Name | Type | Required | Description |

**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `token` | `string \| null` | No | The token a runner registers with. |

### actions.runners.delete

`orgs.actions.runners.delete`

Delete an org-level runner

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.orgs.actions.runners.delete({ org: 'acme', runner_id: '5' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `org` | `string` | Yes | name of the organization |
| `runner_id` | `string \| number` | Yes | id of the runner |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |
