### actions.secrets.delete

`orgs.actions.secrets.delete`

Delete a secret in an organization

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.orgs.actions.secrets.delete({ org: 'acme', secretname: 'DEPLOY_TOKEN' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `org` | `string` | Yes | name of organization |
| `secretname` | `string` | Yes | name of the secret |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### actions.secrets.list

`orgs.actions.secrets.list`

List an organization's actions secrets, one page at a time

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.orgs.actions.secrets.list({ org: 'acme' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `org` | `string` | Yes | name of the organization |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="items full type">

```ts
{
  created_at?: string | null,
  description?: string | null,
  name?: string | null
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### actions.secrets.set

`orgs.actions.secrets.set`

Create or Update a secret value in an organization

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.orgs.actions.secrets.set({ org: 'acme', secretname: 'DEPLOY_TOKEN', data: 'secret-value' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `org` | `string` | Yes | name of organization |
| `secretname` | `string` | Yes | name of the secret |
| `data` | `string` | Yes | Data of the secret to update |
| `description` | `string` | No | Description of the secret to update |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### actions.variables.create

`orgs.actions.variables.create`

Create an org-level variable

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.orgs.actions.variables.create({ org: 'acme', variablename: 'NODE_VERSION', value: '20' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `org` | `string` | Yes | name of the organization |
| `variablename` | `string` | Yes | name of the variable |
| `description` | `string` | No | Description of the variable to create |
| `value` | `string` | Yes | Value of the variable to create |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

```ts
	type: 'dingtalk',
	config: {},
});
```

| `authorization_header` | `string` | No | Authorization header to include in webhook requests |
| `branch_filter` | `string` | No | Branch filter pattern to determine which branches trigger the webhook |
| `config` | `Record<string, string>` | Yes | CreateHookOptionConfig has all config options in it required are "content_type" and "url" Required |
| `events` | `string[]` | No | List of events that will trigger this webhook |

| `type` | `dingtalk \| discord \| gitea \| gogs \| msteams \| slack \| telegram \| feishu \| wechatwork \| packagist` | Yes | The type of the webhook to create |

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `active` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the webhook is active and will be triggered |

| `config` | `Record<string, string> \| null` | No | Configuration settings for the webhook |
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | The date and time when the webhook was created |
| `events` | `string[] \| null` | No | List of events that trigger this webhook |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | The unique identifier of the webhook |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Optional human-readable name for the webhook |
| `type` | `string \| null` | No | The type of the webhook (e.g., gitea, slack, discord) |
| `updated_at` | `string \| null` | No | The date and time when the webhook was last updated |

### teams.create

`orgs.teams.create`

Create a team

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.orgs.teams.create({ org: 'acme', name: 'website' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `org` | `string` | Yes | name of the organization |
| `can_create_org_repo` | `boolean` | No | Whether the team can create repositories in the organization |
| `description` | `string` | No | The description of the team |
| `includes_all_repositories` | `boolean` | No | Whether the team has access to all repositories in the organization |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `permission` | `read \| write \| admin` | No | All units have this permission (read/write/admin) |
| `units` | `string[]` | No | Deprecated: This variable should be replaced by UnitsMap and will be dropped in later versions. |
| `units_map` | `Record<string, string>` | No | — |
| `visibility` | `public \| limited \| private` | No | Team visibility within the organization. Defaults to "private". |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `can_create_org_repo` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the team can create repositories in the organization |
| `description` | `string \| null` | No | The description of the team |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | The unique identifier of the team |
| `includes_all_repositories` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the team has access to all repositories in the organization |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | The name of the team |
| `organization` | `object \| null` | No | Organization represents an organization |
| `permission` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `units` | `string[] \| null` | No | Deprecated: This variable should be replaced by UnitsMap and will be dropped in later versions. |
| `units_map` | `Record<string, string> \| null` | No | — |
| `visibility` | `string \| null` | No | Team visibility within the organization. "private" teams are only listable by members and org owners; "limited" teams are listable by any organization member; "public" teams are listable by any signed-in user. |

<Accordion title="organization full type">

```ts

  avatar_url?: string | null,

  location?: string | null,
  name?: string | null,
  repo_admin_change_team_access?: boolean | null,
  username?: string | null,
  visibility?: string | null,
  website?: string | null
} | null
```

### update

`orgs.update`

Edit an organization

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.orgs.update({ org: 'acme' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `org` | `string` | Yes | name of the organization to edit |
| `description` | `string` | No | The description of the organization |
| `email` | `string` | No | The email address of the organization; use empty string to clear |
| `full_name` | `string` | No | The full display name of the organization |
| `location` | `string` | No | The location of the organization |
| `repo_admin_change_team_access` | `boolean` | No | Whether repository administrators can change team access |
| `visibility` | `public \| limited \| private` | No | possible values are `public`, `limited` or `private` |
| `website` | `string` | No | The website URL of the organization |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `avatar_url` | `string \| null` | No | The URL of the organization's avatar |
| `description` | `string \| null` | No | The description of the organization |
| `email` | `string \| null` | No | The email address of the organization |
| `full_name` | `string \| null` | No | The full display name of the organization |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | The unique identifier of the organization |
| `location` | `string \| null` | No | The location of the organization |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | The name of the organization |
| `repo_admin_change_team_access` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether repository administrators can change team access |
| `username` | `string \| null` | No | username of the organization deprecated |
| `visibility` | `string \| null` | No | The visibility level of the organization (public, limited, private) |
| `website` | `string \| null` | No | The website URL of the organization |

### delete

`packages.delete`

Delete a package

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.packages.delete({ owner: 'ada', type: 'npm', name: 'website' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the package |
| `type` | `string` | Yes | type of the package |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | name of the package |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### link

`packages.link`

Link a package to a repository

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.packages.link({
	owner: 'ada',
	type: 'npm',
	name: 'website',
	repo_name: 'tea',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the package |
| `type` | `string` | Yes | type of the package |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | name of the package |
| `repo_name` | `string` | Yes | name of the repository to link. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### unlink

`packages.unlink`

Unlink a package from a repository

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.packages.unlink({ owner: 'ada', type: 'npm', name: 'website' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the package |
| `type` | `string` | Yes | type of the package |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | name of the package |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### versions.delete

`packages.versions.delete`

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.packages.versions.delete({
	owner: 'ada',
	type: 'npm',
	name: 'website',
	version: '1.0.0',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the package |
| `type` | `string` | Yes | type of the package |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | name of the package |
| `version` | `string` | Yes | version of the package |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### versions.get

`packages.versions.get`

Gets a package

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.packages.versions.get({
	owner: 'ada',
	type: 'npm',
	name: 'website',
	version: '1.0.0',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the package |
| `type` | `string` | Yes | type of the package |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | name of the package |
| `version` | `string` | Yes | version of the package |

---

### versions.list

`packages.versions.list`

Gets all versions of a package, one page at a time

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.packages.versions.list({ owner: 'ada', type: 'npm', name: 'website' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the package |
| `type` | `string` | Yes | type of the package |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | name of the package |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

---

### downloadDiff

`pulls.downloadDiff`

Get a pull request diff or patch (returned as text)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.pulls.downloadDiff({
	owner: 'ada',
	repo: 'website',
	index: 4,
	diffType: 'diff',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `index` | `number` | Yes | index of the pull request to get |
| `diffType` | `diff \| patch` | Yes | whether the output is diff or patch |
| `binary` | `boolean` | No | whether to include binary file changes. if true, the diff is applicable with `git apply` |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `text` | `string` | Yes | The body Gitea answered with (text, HTML or a diff). |



---

### files

`pulls.files`

Get changed files for a pull request, one page at a time

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.pulls.files({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', index: 4 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `index` | `number` | Yes | index of the pull request to get |
| `skip-to` | `string` | No | skip to given file |
| `whitespace` | `ignore-all \| ignore-change \| ignore-eol \| show-all` | No | whitespace behavior |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

```ts
}[]
```

### get

`pulls.get`

Get a pull request

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.pulls.get({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', index: 4 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `index` | `number` | Yes | index of the pull request to get |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `additions` | `number \| null` | No | The number of lines added in the pull request |
| `allow_maintainer_edit` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether maintainers can edit the pull request |
| `assignee` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |
| `assignees` | `object[] \| null` | No | The list of users assigned to the pull request |
| `base` | `object \| null` | No | PRBranchInfo information about a branch |
| `body` | `string \| null` | No | The description body of the pull request |
| `changed_files` | `number \| null` | No | The number of files changed in the pull request |
| `closed_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `comments` | `number \| null` | No | The number of comments on the pull request |
| `content_version` | `number \| null` | No | The version of the pull request content for optimistic locking |
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `deletions` | `number \| null` | No | The number of lines deleted in the pull request |
| `diff_url` | `string \| null` | No | The URL to download the diff patch |
| `draft` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the pull request is a draft |
| `due_date` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `head` | `object \| null` | No | PRBranchInfo information about a branch |
| `html_url` | `string \| null` | No | The HTML URL to view the pull request |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | The unique identifier of the pull request |
| `is_locked` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the pull request conversation is locked |
| `labels` | `object[] \| null` | No | The labels attached to the pull request |
| `merge_base` | `string \| null` | No | The merge base commit SHA |
| `merge_commit_sha` | `string \| null` | No | The SHA of the merge commit |
| `mergeable` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the pull request can be merged |
| `merged` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the pull request has been merged |
| `merged_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `merged_by` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |
| `milestone` | `object \| null` | No | Milestone milestone is a collection of issues on one repository |
| `number` | `number \| null` | No | The pull request number |
| `patch_url` | `string \| null` | No | The URL to download the patch file |
| `pin_order` | `number \| null` | No | The pin order for the pull request |
| `requested_reviewers` | `object[] \| null` | No | The users requested to review the pull request |
| `requested_reviewers_teams` | `object[] \| null` | No | The teams requested to review the pull request |
| `review_comments` | `number \| null` | No | number of review comments made on the diff of a PR review (not including comments on commits or issues in a PR) |
| `state` | `string \| null` | No | The current state of the pull request |
| `title` | `string \| null` | No | The title of the pull request |
| `updated_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | The API URL of the pull request |
| `user` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |

---

### getByBaseHead

`pulls.getByBaseHead`

Get a pull request by base and head

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.pulls.getByBaseHead({
	owner: 'ada',
	repo: 'website',
	base: 'main',
	head: 'feature/login',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `base` | `string` | Yes | base of the pull request to get |
| `head` | `string` | Yes | head of the pull request to get |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `additions` | `number \| null` | No | The number of lines added in the pull request |
| `allow_maintainer_edit` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether maintainers can edit the pull request |
| `assignee` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |
| `assignees` | `object[] \| null` | No | The list of users assigned to the pull request |
| `base` | `object \| null` | No | PRBranchInfo information about a branch |
| `body` | `string \| null` | No | The description body of the pull request |
| `changed_files` | `number \| null` | No | The number of files changed in the pull request |
| `closed_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `comments` | `number \| null` | No | The number of comments on the pull request |
| `content_version` | `number \| null` | No | The version of the pull request content for optimistic locking |
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `deletions` | `number \| null` | No | The number of lines deleted in the pull request |
| `diff_url` | `string \| null` | No | The URL to download the diff patch |
| `draft` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the pull request is a draft |
| `due_date` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `head` | `object \| null` | No | PRBranchInfo information about a branch |
| `html_url` | `string \| null` | No | The HTML URL to view the pull request |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | The unique identifier of the pull request |
| `is_locked` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the pull request conversation is locked |
| `labels` | `object[] \| null` | No | The labels attached to the pull request |
| `merge_base` | `string \| null` | No | The merge base commit SHA |
| `merge_commit_sha` | `string \| null` | No | The SHA of the merge commit |
| `mergeable` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the pull request can be merged |
| `merged` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the pull request has been merged |
| `merged_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `merged_by` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |
| `milestone` | `object \| null` | No | Milestone milestone is a collection of issues on one repository |
| `number` | `number \| null` | No | The pull request number |
| `patch_url` | `string \| null` | No | The URL to download the patch file |
| `pin_order` | `number \| null` | No | The pin order for the pull request |
| `requested_reviewers` | `object[] \| null` | No | The users requested to review the pull request |
| `requested_reviewers_teams` | `object[] \| null` | No | The teams requested to review the pull request |
| `review_comments` | `number \| null` | No | number of review comments made on the diff of a PR review (not including comments on commits or issues in a PR) |
| `state` | `string \| null` | No | The current state of the pull request |
| `title` | `string \| null` | No | The title of the pull request |
| `updated_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | The API URL of the pull request |
| `user` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |

---

### isMerged

`pulls.isMerged`

Check if a pull request has been merged

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.pulls.isMerged({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', index: 4 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `index` | `number` | Yes | index of the pull request |



**Output:** `any`


---

### list

`pulls.list`

List a repo's pull requests, one page at a time

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.pulls.list({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | Name of the repo |
| `base_branch` | `string` | No | Filter by target base branch of the pull request |
| `state` | `open \| closed \| all` | No | State of pull request |
| `sort` | `oldest \| recentupdate \| recentclose \| leastupdate \| mostcomment \| leastcomment \| priority` | No | Type of sort |
| `milestone` | `number` | No | ID of the milestone |
| `labels` | `number[]` | No | Label IDs |
| `poster` | `string` | No | Filter by pull request author |
| `page` | `number` | No | Page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | Page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

### listPinned

`pulls.listPinned`

List a repo's pinned pull requests

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.pulls.listPinned({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |

### merge

`pulls.merge`

Merge a pull request with the chosen style (merge, rebase, rebase-merge, squash, fast-forward-only or manually-merged), optionally deleting the head branch, or schedule it to merge when checks pass

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.pulls.merge({
	owner: 'ada',
	repo: 'website',
	index: 5,
	do: 'squash',
	delete_branch_after_merge: true,
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `index` | `number` | Yes | index of the pull request to merge |
| `delete_branch_after_merge` | `boolean` | No | — |
| `do` | `merge \| rebase \| rebase-merge \| squash \| fast-forward-only \| manually-merged` | Yes | — |
| `force_merge` | `boolean` | No | — |
| `head_commit_id` | `string` | No | — |
| `merge_commit_id` | `string` | No | — |
| `merge_message_field` | `string` | No | — |
| `merge_title_field` | `string` | No | — |
| `merge_when_checks_succeed` | `boolean` | No | — |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### updateBranch

`pulls.updateBranch`

Merge PR's baseBranch into headBranch

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.pulls.updateBranch({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', index: 4 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `index` | `number` | Yes | index of the pull request to get |
| `style` | `merge \| rebase` | No | how to update pull request |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

## Releases

### assets.create

`releases.assets.create`

Create a release attachment

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.releases.assets.create({
	owner: 'ada',
	repo: 'website',
	id: 12,
	attachment: { base64: 'iVBORw0KGgo=', filename: 'screenshot.png', contentType: 'image/png' },
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `id` | `number` | Yes | id of the release |
| `name` | `string` | No | name of the attachment |
| `attachment` | `string \| object \| custom` | No | attachment to upload |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="attachment full type">

```ts
string | {
  url: string,
  filename?: string,
  contentType?: string
} | {
  base64: string,
  filename?: string,
  contentType?: string
} | custom
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `browser_download_url` | `string \| null` | No | DownloadURL is the URL to download the attachment |
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | Created is the time when the attachment was uploaded |
| `download_count` | `number \| null` | No | DownloadCount is the number of times the attachment has been downloaded |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | ID is the unique identifier for the attachment |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Name is the filename of the attachment |
| `size` | `number \| null` | No | Size is the file size in bytes |
| `uuid` | `string \| null` | No | UUID is the unique identifier for the attachment file |

### assets.delete

`releases.assets.delete`

Delete a release attachment

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.releases.assets.delete({
	owner: 'ada',
	repo: 'website',
	id: 12,
	attachment_id: 3,
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `id` | `number` | Yes | id of the release |
| `attachment_id` | `number` | Yes | id of the attachment to delete |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### create

`releases.create`

Create a release for a tag, creating the tag on the target commit when it does not exist yet; a tag that already has a release answers 409

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.releases.create({
	owner: 'ada',
	repo: 'website',
	tag_name: 'v1.0.0',
	name: 'v1.0.0',
	target_commitish: 'main',
	body: 'First release',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `body` | `string` | No | The release notes or description |
| `draft` | `boolean` | No | Whether to create the release as a draft |
| `name` | `string` | No | The display title of the release |
| `prerelease` | `boolean` | No | Whether to mark the release as a prerelease |
| `tag_message` | `string` | No | The message for the git tag |
| `tag_name` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `target_commitish` | `string` | No | The target commitish for the release |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `assets` | `object[] \| null` | No | The files attached to the release |
| `author` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |
| `body` | `string \| null` | No | The release notes or description |
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `draft` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the release is a draft |
| `html_url` | `string \| null` | No | The HTML URL to view the release |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | The unique identifier of the release |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | The display title of the release |
| `prerelease` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the release is a prerelease |
| `published_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `tag_name` | `string \| null` | No | The name of the git tag associated with the release |
| `tarball_url` | `string \| null` | No | The URL to download the tarball archive |
| `target_commitish` | `string \| null` | No | The target commitish for the release |
| `upload_url` | `string \| null` | No | The URL template for uploading release assets |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | The API URL of the release |
| `zipball_url` | `string \| null` | No | The URL to download the zip archive |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="assets full type">

```ts

  browser_download_url?: string | null,
  created_at?: string | null,
  download_count?: number | null,
  id?: number | null,

  uuid?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>

### list

`releases.list`

List a repository's releases with their assets, filterable by draft and prerelease, one page at a time

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.releases.list({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `draft` | `boolean` | No | filter (exclude / include) drafts, if you don't have repo write access none will show |
| `pre-release` | `boolean` | No | filter (exclude / include) pre-releases |
| `tag_filter` | `string` | No | filter releases by tag. supports "*" as a wildcard (for example: v1*, *beta, *rc*). |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

### activityFeeds.list

`repos.activityFeeds.list`

List a repository's activity feeds, one page at a time

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.repos.activityFeeds.list({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `date` | `string` | No | the date of the activities to be found |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

### create

Create a repository owned by the authenticated user, optionally seeded with a README, license and gitignore

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
	name: 'demo',
	auto_init: true,
	description: 'Scratch repository',
	private: true,
});
```

### delete

`repos.delete`

Permanently delete a repository together with its issues, pull requests, releases and wiki; no API call can restore it

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.repos.delete({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'demo' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo to delete |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo to delete |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### deployKeys.create

`repos.deployKeys.create`

Add a key to a repository

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.repos.deployKeys.create({
	owner: 'ada',
	repo: 'website',
	title: 'Login fails on Safari',
	key: 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIGitea0example0key0value0for0docs ada@example.com',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `key` | `string` | Yes | An armored SSH key to add |
| `read_only` | `boolean` | No | Describe if the key has only read access or read/write |
| `title` | `string` | Yes | Title of the key to add |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | Created is the time when the deploy-key was added |
| `fingerprint` | `string \| null` | No | Fingerprint is the key's fingerprint |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | ID is the unique identifier for the deploy-key |
| `key` | `string \| null` | No | Key contains the actual SSH key content |
| `key_id` | `number \| null` | No | KeyID is the associated public key ID |
| `key_type` | `string \| null` | No | Type tells whether the key authenticates over SSH or with a token over HTTPS |
| `read_only` | `boolean \| null` | No | ReadOnly indicates if the key has read-only access |
| `repository` | `object \| null` | No | Repository represents a repository |
| `title` | `string \| null` | No | Title is the human-readable name for the key |
| `token` | `string \| null` | No | Token is the plaintext token of an HTTPS key, only returned when it is created |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | URL is the API URL for this deploy-key |

### deployKeys.createToken

`repos.deployKeys.createToken`

Add a deploy token to a repository, it authenticates git over HTTPS

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.repos.deployKeys.createToken({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', title: 'Login fails on Safari' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `read_only` | `boolean` | No | Describe if the token has only read access or read/write |
| `title` | `string` | Yes | Title of the token to add |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | Created is the time when the deploy-key was added |
| `fingerprint` | `string \| null` | No | Fingerprint is the key's fingerprint |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | ID is the unique identifier for the deploy-key |
| `key` | `string \| null` | No | Key contains the actual SSH key content |
| `key_id` | `number \| null` | No | KeyID is the associated public key ID |
| `key_type` | `string \| null` | No | Type tells whether the key authenticates over SSH or with a token over HTTPS |
| `read_only` | `boolean \| null` | No | ReadOnly indicates if the key has read-only access |
| `repository` | `object \| null` | No | Repository represents a repository |
| `title` | `string \| null` | No | Title is the human-readable name for the key |
| `token` | `string \| null` | No | Token is the plaintext token of an HTTPS key, only returned when it is created |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | URL is the API URL for this deploy-key |

### deployKeys.delete

`repos.deployKeys.delete`

Delete a key from a repository

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.repos.deployKeys.delete({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', id: 12 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `id` | `number` | Yes | id of the key to delete |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### deployKeys.get

`repos.deployKeys.get`

Get a repository's key by id

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.repos.deployKeys.get({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', id: 12 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `id` | `number` | Yes | id of the key to get |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | Created is the time when the deploy-key was added |
| `fingerprint` | `string \| null` | No | Fingerprint is the key's fingerprint |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | ID is the unique identifier for the deploy-key |
| `key` | `string \| null` | No | Key contains the actual SSH key content |
| `key_id` | `number \| null` | No | KeyID is the associated public key ID |
| `key_type` | `string \| null` | No | Type tells whether the key authenticates over SSH or with a token over HTTPS |
| `read_only` | `boolean \| null` | No | ReadOnly indicates if the key has read-only access |
| `repository` | `object \| null` | No | Repository represents a repository |
| `title` | `string \| null` | No | Title is the human-readable name for the key |
| `token` | `string \| null` | No | Token is the plaintext token of an HTTPS key, only returned when it is created |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | URL is the API URL for this deploy-key |

### deployKeys.list

`repos.deployKeys.list`

List a repository's keys, one page at a time

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.repos.deployKeys.list({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `key_id` | `number` | No | the key_id to search for |
| `fingerprint` | `string` | No | fingerprint of the key |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

### downloadArchive

`repos.downloadArchive`

Get an archive of a repository (returned as a file)

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.repos.downloadArchive({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', archive: 'main.zip' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `archive` | `string` | Yes | the git reference for download with attached archive format (e.g. master.zip) |
| `path` | `string[]` | No | subpath of the repository to download |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contentBase64` | `string` | No | The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set. |
| `text` | `string` | No | The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8. |
| `contentType` | `string` | Yes | Media type of the file, for example application/pdf. |
| `byteLength` | `number` | Yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `filename` | `string` | No | The file name, when known. |
| `contentOmitted` | `not_requested \| over_limit` | No | Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit. |
| `fileId` | `string` | No | Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text. |

### forks.create

`repos.forks.create`

Fork a repository

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.repos.forks.create({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo to fork |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo to fork |
| `name` | `string` | No | name of the forked repository |

### forks.list

`repos.forks.list`

List a repository's forks, one page at a time

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.repos.forks.list({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

### generateFromTemplate

`repos.generateFromTemplate`

Create a repository using a template

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.repos.generateFromTemplate({
	template_owner: 'acme',
	template_repo: 'service-template',
	owner: 'ada',
	name: 'website',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `template_owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the template repository |
| `template_repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the template repository |
| `avatar` | `boolean` | No | include avatar of the template repo |
| `default_branch` | `string` | No | Default branch of the new repository |
| `description` | `string` | No | Description of the repository to create |
| `git_content` | `boolean` | No | include git content of default branch in template repo |
| `git_hooks` | `boolean` | No | include git hooks in template repo |
| `labels` | `boolean` | No | include labels in template repo |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | the organization's name or individual user's name who will own the new repository |
| `private` | `boolean` | No | Whether the repository is private |
| `protected_branch` | `boolean` | No | include protected branches in template repo |
| `topics` | `boolean` | No | include topics in template repo |
| `webhooks` | `boolean` | No | include webhooks in template repo |

### gitHooks.delete

`repos.gitHooks.delete`

Delete a Git hook in a repository

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.repos.gitHooks.delete({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', id: '12' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `id` | `string \| number` | Yes | id of the hook to get |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |



---

### gitHooks.get

`repos.gitHooks.get`

Get a Git hook

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.repos.gitHooks.get({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', id: '12' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `id` | `string \| number` | Yes | id of the hook to get |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `content` | `string \| null` | No | Content contains the script content of the hook |
| `is_active` | `boolean \| null` | No | IsActive indicates if the hook is active |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Name is the name of the Git hook |

### gitHooks.update

`repos.gitHooks.update`

Edit a Git hook in a repository

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.repos.gitHooks.update({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', id: '12' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `id` | `string \| number` | Yes | id of the hook to get |
| `content` | `string` | No | Content is the new script content for the hook |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|

| `is_active` | `boolean \| null` | No | IsActive indicates if the hook is active |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Name is the name of the Git hook |

### list

`repos.list`

List the repositories the authenticated user owns or can access, one page at a time

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.repos.list({ limit: 50 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

### search

`repos.search`

Search for repositories

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.repos.search({ q: 'cli', limit: 10 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `q` | `string` | No | keyword |
| `topic` | `boolean` | No | Limit search to repositories with keyword as topic |
| `includeDesc` | `boolean` | No | include search of keyword within repository description |
| `uid` | `number` | No | search only for repos that the user with the given id owns or contributes to |
| `priority_owner_id` | `number` | No | repo owner to prioritize in the results |
| `team_id` | `number` | No | search only for repos that belong to the given team id |
| `starredBy` | `number` | No | search only for repos that the user with the given id has starred |
| `private` | `boolean` | No | include private repositories this user has access to (defaults to true) |
| `is_private` | `boolean` | No | show only pubic, private or all repositories (defaults to all) |
| `template` | `boolean` | No | include template repositories this user has access to (defaults to true) |
| `archived` | `boolean` | No | show only archived, non-archived or all repositories (defaults to all) |
| `mode` | `string` | No | type of repository to search for. Supported values are "fork", "source", "mirror" and "collaborative" |
| `exclusive` | `boolean` | No | if `uid` is given, search only for repos that the user owns |
| `sort` | `string` | No | sort repos by attribute. Supported values are "alpha", "created", "updated", "size", "git_size", "lfs_size", "stars", "forks" and "id". Default is "alpha" |
| `order` | `string` | No | sort order, either "asc" (ascending) or "desc" (descending). Default is "asc", ignored if "sort" is not specified. |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | Data contains the repository search results |
| `ok` | `boolean \| null` | No | OK indicates if the search was successful |

### transfer

`repos.transfer`

Transfer the repository to another user or organization (the new owner may have to accept it)

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.repos.transfer({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', new_owner: 'acme' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo to transfer |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo to transfer |
| `new_owner` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `team_ids` | `number[]` | No | ID of the team or teams to add to the repository. Teams can only be added to organization-owned repositories. |

### update

`repos.update`

Edit a repository's properties. Only fields that are set will be changed

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.repos.update({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo to edit |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo to edit |
| `allow_fast_forward_only_merge` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to allow fast-forward-only merging pull requests, or `false` to prevent fast-forward-only merging. |
| `allow_manual_merge` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to allow mark pr as merged manually, or `false` to prevent it. |
| `allow_merge_commits` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to allow merging pull requests with a merge commit, or `false` to prevent merging pull requests with merge commits. |
| `allow_merge_update` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to allow updating pull request branch by merge, or `false` to prevent it. |
| `allow_rebase` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to allow rebase-merging pull requests, or `false` to prevent rebase-merging. |
| `allow_rebase_explicit` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to allow rebase with explicit merge commits (--no-ff), or `false` to prevent rebase with explicit merge commits. |
| `allow_rebase_update` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to allow updating pull request branch by rebase, or `false` to prevent it. |
| `allow_squash_merge` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to allow squash-merging pull requests, or `false` to prevent squash-merging. |
| `archived` | `boolean` | No | set to `true` to archive this repository. |
| `autodetect_manual_merge` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to enable AutodetectManualMerge, or `false` to prevent it. Note: In some special cases, misjudgments can occur. |
| `default_allow_maintainer_edit` | `boolean` | No | set to `true` to allow edits from maintainers by default |
| `default_branch` | `string` | No | sets the default branch for this repository. |
| `default_delete_branch_after_merge` | `boolean` | No | set to `true` to delete pr branch after merge by default |
| `default_merge_style` | `string` | No | set to a merge style to be used by this repository: "merge", "rebase", "rebase-merge", "squash", or "fast-forward-only". |
| `default_update_style` | `string` | No | set to an update style to be used by this repository: "merge" or "rebase". |
| `description` | `string` | No | a short description of the repository. |
| `enable_prune` | `boolean` | No | enable prune - remove obsolete remote-tracking references when mirroring |
| `external_tracker` | `object` | No | ExternalTracker represents settings for external tracker |
| `external_wiki` | `object` | No | ExternalWiki represents setting for external wiki |
| `has_actions` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to enable actions unit, or `false` to disable them. |
| `has_code` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to enable code for this repository or `false` to disable it. |
| `has_issues` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to enable issues for this repository or `false` to disable them. |
| `has_packages` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to enable packages unit, or `false` to disable them. |
| `has_projects` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to enable project unit, or `false` to disable them. |
| `has_pull_requests` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to allow pull requests, or `false` to prevent pull request. |
| `has_releases` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to enable releases unit, or `false` to disable them. |
| `has_wiki` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to enable the wiki for this repository or `false` to disable it. |
| `ignore_whitespace_conflicts` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to ignore whitespace for conflicts, or `false` to not ignore whitespace. |
| `internal_tracker` | `object` | No | InternalTracker represents settings for internal tracker |
| `mirror_interval` | `string` | No | set to a string like `8h30m0s` to set the mirror interval time |
| `mirror_password` | `string` | No | authentication password for the remote repository (mirrors) |
| `mirror_token` | `string` | No | authentication token for the remote repository (mirrors) |
| `mirror_username` | `string` | No | authentication username for the remote repository (mirrors) |
| `name` | `string` | No | name of the repository |
| `private` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to make the repository private or `false` to make it public. Note: you will get a 422 error if the organization restricts changing repository visibility to organization owners and a non-owner tries to change the value of private. |
| `projects_mode` | `string` | No | `repo` to only allow repo-level projects, `owner` to only allow owner projects, `all` to allow both. |
| `template` | `boolean` | No | either `true` to make this repository a template or `false` to make it a normal repository |
| `website` | `string` | No | a URL with more information about the repository. |

## Settings

### api

`settings.api`

Get instance's global settings for api

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.settings.api({});
```

**Input:** _empty object_


**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `default_git_trees_per_page` | `number \| null` | No | DefaultGitTreesPerPage is the default number of Git tree items per page |
| `default_max_blob_size` | `number \| null` | No | DefaultMaxBlobSize is the default maximum blob size for API responses |
| `default_max_response_size` | `number \| null` | No | DefaultMaxResponseSize is the default maximum response size |
| `default_paging_num` | `number \| null` | No | DefaultPagingNum is the default number of items per page |
| `max_response_items` | `number \| null` | No | MaxResponseItems is the maximum number of items returned in API responses |



---

### attachment

`settings.attachment`

Get instance's global settings for Attachment

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.settings.attachment({});
```

**Input:** _empty object_


**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `allowed_types` | `string \| null` | No | AllowedTypes contains the allowed file types for attachments |
| `enabled` | `boolean \| null` | No | Enabled indicates if file attachments are enabled |
| `max_files` | `number \| null` | No | MaxFiles is the maximum number of files per attachment |
| `max_size` | `number \| null` | No | MaxSize is the maximum size for individual attachments |

| `migrations_disabled` | `boolean \| null` | No | MigrationsDisabled indicates if repository migrations are disabled |
| `mirrors_disabled` | `boolean \| null` | No | MirrorsDisabled indicates if repository mirroring is disabled |
| `stars_disabled` | `boolean \| null` | No | StarsDisabled indicates if repository starring is disabled |

## Tag Protections

### create

`tagProtections.create`

Create a tag protections for a repository

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.tagProtections.create({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `name_pattern` | `string` | No | The pattern to match tag names for protection |
| `whitelist_teams` | `string[]` | No | List of team names allowed to create/delete protected tags |
| `whitelist_usernames` | `string[]` | No | List of usernames allowed to create/delete protected tags |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | The date and time when the tag protection was created |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | The unique identifier of the tag protection |
| `name_pattern` | `string \| null` | No | The pattern to match tag names for protection |
| `updated_at` | `string \| null` | No | The date and time when the tag protection was last updated |
| `whitelist_teams` | `string[] \| null` | No | List of team names allowed to create/delete protected tags |
| `whitelist_usernames` | `string[] \| null` | No | List of usernames allowed to create/delete protected tags |



---

### delete

`tagProtections.delete`

Delete a specific tag protection for the repository

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.tagProtections.delete({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', id: 12 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `id` | `number` | Yes | id of protected tag |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

---

### repos.list

`teams.repos.list`

List a team's repos, one page at a time

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.teams.repos.list({ id: 12 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number` | Yes | id of the team |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### update

`teams.update`

**Input**

|------|------|----------|-------------|

| `can_create_org_repo` | `boolean` | No | Whether the team can create repositories in the organization |
| `description` | `string` | No | The description of the team |
| `includes_all_repositories` | `boolean` | No | Whether the team has access to all repositories in the organization |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `permission` | `read \| write \| admin` | No | All units have this permission (read/write/admin) |
| `units` | `string[]` | No | Deprecated: This variable should be replaced by UnitsMap and will be dropped in later versions. |
| `units_map` | `Record<string, string>` | No | — |
| `visibility` | `public \| limited \| private` | No | Team visibility within the organization. When omitted, visibility is left unchanged. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `can_create_org_repo` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the team can create repositories in the organization |
| `description` | `string \| null` | No | The description of the team |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | The unique identifier of the team |
| `includes_all_repositories` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the team has access to all repositories in the organization |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | The name of the team |
| `organization` | `object \| null` | No | Organization represents an organization |
| `permission` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `units` | `string[] \| null` | No | Deprecated: This variable should be replaced by UnitsMap and will be dropped in later versions. |
| `units_map` | `Record<string, string> \| null` | No | — |
| `visibility` | `string \| null` | No | Team visibility within the organization. "private" teams are only listable by members and org owners; "limited" teams are listable by any organization member; "public" teams are listable by any signed-in user. |

### actions.secrets.delete

`user.actions.secrets.delete`

Delete a secret in a user scope

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.user.actions.secrets.delete({ secretname: 'DEPLOY_TOKEN' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `secretname` | `string` | Yes | name of the secret |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

`user.actions.secrets.set`

Create or Update a secret value in a user scope

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### actions.variables.list

`user.actions.variables.list`

Get the user-level list of variables which is created by current doer, one page at a time

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.user.actions.variables.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="items full type">

```ts
{
  data?: string | null,
  description?: string | null,
  name?: string | null,
  owner_id?: number | null,
  repo_id?: number | null
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

Get a public key

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.user.keys.get({ id: 12 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `number` | Yes | id of key to get |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | Created is the time when the key was added |
| `fingerprint` | `string \| null` | No | Fingerprint is the key's fingerprint |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | ID is the unique identifier for the public key |
| `key` | `string \| null` | No | Key contains the actual SSH public key content |
| `key_type` | `string \| null` | No | KeyType indicates the type of the SSH key |
| `last_used_at` | `string \| null` | No | Updated is the time when the key was last used |
| `read_only` | `boolean \| null` | No | ReadOnly indicates if the key has read-only access |
| `title` | `string \| null` | No | Title is the human-readable name for the key |
| `url` | `string \| null` | No | URL is the API URL for this key |
| `user` | `object \| null` | No | User represents a user |

### starred.star

`user.starred.star`

Star the given repo

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.user.starred.star({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo to star |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo to star |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

### stopwatches.list

`user.stopwatches.list`

Get list of all existing stopwatches, one page at a time

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.user.stopwatches.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

### trackedTimes.list

`user.trackedTimes.list`

List the current user's tracked times, one page at a time

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.user.trackedTimes.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |
| `since` | `string` | No | Only show times updated after the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format |
| `before` | `string` | No | Only show times updated before the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

## Users

### activityFeeds.list

`users.activityFeeds.list`

List a user's activity feeds, one page at a time

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.users.activityFeeds.list({ username: 'ada' });
```

|------|------|----------|-------------|

| `only-performed-by` | `boolean` | No | if true, only show actions performed by the requested user |
| `date` | `string` | No | the date of the activities to be found |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |

| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

### following.check

`users.following.check`

Check if one user is following another user

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.users.following.check({ username: 'ada', target: 'grace' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|

### starred.list

`users.starred.list`

The repos that the given user has starred, one page at a time

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.users.starred.list({ username: 'ada' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `username` | `string` | Yes | username of the user whose starred repos are to be listed |
| `page` | `number` | No | page number of results to return (1-based) |
| `limit` | `number` | No | page size of results |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `items` | `object[]` | Yes | One page of results. |
| `next_page` | `number \| null` | Yes | The page to ask for next: set while this page came back full (limit; 50 when left out), null once it came back short. |

## Webhooks

### create

`webhooks.create`

Register a webhook on a repository: target URL, payload type, events and an optional signing secret. With type 'gitea' and a secret, the plugin's webhooks verify the deliveries

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.webhooks.create({
	owner: 'ada',
	repo: 'website',
	type: 'gitea',
	active: true,
	events: ['push', 'issues', 'pull_request', 'release'],
	config: { url: 'https://example.com/gitea/webhooks', content_type: 'json', secret: 'a-long-random-secret' },
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `active` | `boolean` | No | Whether the webhook should be active upon creation |
| `authorization_header` | `string` | No | Authorization header to include in webhook requests |
| `branch_filter` | `string` | No | Branch filter pattern to determine which branches trigger the webhook |
| `config` | `Record<string, string>` | Yes | CreateHookOptionConfig has all config options in it required are "content_type" and "url" Required |
| `events` | `string[]` | No | List of events that will trigger this webhook |
| `name` | `string` | No | Optional human-readable name for the webhook |
| `type` | `dingtalk \| discord \| gitea \| gogs \| msteams \| slack \| telegram \| feishu \| wechatwork \| packagist` | Yes | The type of the webhook to create |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `active` | `boolean \| null` | No | Whether the webhook is active and will be triggered |
| `authorization_header` | `string \| null` | No | Authorization header to include in webhook requests |
| `branch_filter` | `string \| null` | No | Branch filter pattern to determine which branches trigger the webhook |
| `config` | `Record<string, string> \| null` | No | Configuration settings for the webhook |
| `created_at` | `string \| null` | No | The date and time when the webhook was created |
| `events` | `string[] \| null` | No | List of events that trigger this webhook |
| `id` | `number \| null` | No | The unique identifier of the webhook |
| `name` | `string \| null` | No | Optional human-readable name for the webhook |
| `type` | `string \| null` | No | The type of the webhook (e.g., gitea, slack, discord) |
| `updated_at` | `string \| null` | No | The date and time when the webhook was last updated |



---

### delete

`webhooks.delete`

Permanently remove a webhook registration; deliveries stop immediately

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.webhooks.delete({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website', id: 12 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `id` | `number` | Yes | id of the hook to delete |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `success` | `true` | Yes | Gitea accepted the call; it answered with no body. |

```ts
  created_at?: string | null,
  events?: string[] | null,
  id?: number | null,
  name?: string | null,
  type?: string | null,
  updated_at?: string | null
}[]
```

## Wiki

### create

`wiki.create`

Create a wiki page

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.gitea.api.wiki.create({ owner: 'ada', repo: 'website' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `owner` | `string` | Yes | owner of the repo |
| `repo` | `string` | Yes | name of the repo |
| `content_base64` | `string` | No | content must be base64 encoded |
| `message` | `string` | No | optional commit message summarizing the change |
| `title` | `string` | No | page title. leave empty to keep unchanged |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `commit_count` | `number \| null` | No | The number of commits that modified this page |
| `content_base64` | `string \| null` | No | Page content, base64 encoded |
| `footer` | `string \| null` | No | The footer content for the wiki page |
| `html_url` | `string \| null` | No | The HTML URL to view the wiki page |
| `last_commit` | `object \| null` | No | WikiCommit page commit/revision |
| `sidebar` | `string \| null` | No | The sidebar content for the wiki page |
| `sub_url` | `string \| null` | No | The sub URL path for the wiki page |
| `title` | `string \| null` | No | The title of the wiki page |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="last_commit full type">

```ts
{
  author?: {
    date?: string | null,
    email?: string | null,
    name?: string | null
  } | null,
  commiter?: {
    date?: string | null,
    email?: string | null,
    name?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  sha?: string | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>
